prose: Latent Space's AINews gives the headline to Felix Rieseberg's 'Hunger beats tenure' post on Anthropic ending coding interviews, and extends his advice for junior engineers: pick business impact over backlog, choose a radical idea, build it over a weekend instead of lobbying through PRDs, focus on one good idea per prototype, and lean into the fresh perspective that newcomers have on user-facing work.
The same issue notes major version bumps from Google Genie, Artificial Analysis and FrontierCode, plus 'impressive math verification' news, as mostly incremental annual improvements.
highlights: AINews extends Rieseberg: business impact over backlog, prototypes over PRDs
One good idea per prototype; fresh eyes as an asset
Roundup: Genie, Artificial Analysis and FrontierCode version bumps
Frames Anthropic's interview change as a path forward for juniors
